# externals

Third-party product integrations (not telemetry).

| Nested | Package |
| --- | --- |
| `figma/` | `@bitcode/externals-figma` |
| `jira/` | `@bitcode/externals-jira` |
| `notion/` | `@bitcode/externals-notion` |
| `vercel/` | `@bitcode/externals-vercel` (deploy API) |

Telemetry for Vercel Analytics lives in `external-telemetry/vercel`.
BC: `@bitcode/{figma,jira,notion,vercel}`.
